articles.title: Shell (LSE:SHEL) Weighs Malaysian Asset Review With Possible $1 Billion Stake Exit
articles.summary: Shell (LSE:SHEL) is reportedly weighing the sale of a majority stake in its Malaysian gas to liquids unit, Shell MDS, as part of a review of selected assets. The potential divestment would reduce Shell's exposure to a specialized downstream technology business in Malaysia and reshape its global asset mix.
